audit.whatIsWrong: Content win[0..6] reads Skill/Singed/Singed/Skill/Skill/Singed/Singed and the full phases match it, but whys[2] through whys[6] all describe Gangplank taking over from level 3 onward ('start chipping faster than his proxy farm pays off', 'out-chip his drain-tank sustain', 'He can't duel my keg burst'). The packet chart and the already-completed mirror audit both give Skill/Singed/Gangplank/Gangplank/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank.
audit.why: Once the second Parrrley and keg points land, Gangplank detonates from far outside Fling's 125 range and Singed has no answer but to proxy. The mirror (singed__gangplank) has already been corrected to exactly this chart, so leaving this side unchanged would guarantee a mirror conflict.
audit.corrected: Both charts set to Skill/Singed/Gangplank/Gangplank/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank, matching the mirror.

audit.why: Spikes match the mirror's corrected pricing: Singed's level 2-3 Fling/proxy window, Gangplank's level 4-5 keg poke, the Sheen first item, and Cannon Barrage as the late answer to proxy splitpush. Four entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer describes Fling as 'His flip. Don't get flung into goo' with no range and no cooldown, and never states the actual conditional: Fling only ROOTS if it lands you inside Mega Adhesive. It also never names Mega Adhesive, Poison Trail or Insanity Potion.
audit.why: Riot text, Fling (E): 'Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' Range 125, cooldown 10/9.5/9/8.5/8. Mega Adhesive (W) is 17/16/15/14/13 at 1000 range and slows plus grounds. Fling's 125 range is shorter than Parrrley's 625 by a wide margin, which is the whole reason the mid-lane phase belongs to Gangplank.
audit.corrected: Fling given its 125 range and 10s cooldown; the glue-then-Fling root condition stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers in the full layer at all.
audit.why: Fling is 10s at rank 1, Mega Adhesive 17s, Remove Scurvy 22s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[9].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere records that Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which halves Remove Scurvy's heal — the single mechanic that decides whether a post-6 trade is survivable.
audit.why: Riot text, Insanity Potion (R): 'granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.' Cooldown 100s. Remove Scurvy is Gangplank's only sustain, so anti-heal on a persistent poison field is a hard downgrade to every extended trade after he drinks.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[4].why, which previously said nothing specific about level 6.
